MonoPaint 0.98 adds watercolor, masking fluid and quick page actions, and works with Supernote firmware 3.30.45.

- **Supernote firmware 3.30.45 works.** On the Manta, the marker under the color
  bar follows the pen again instead of trailing behind it, and buttons give fast
  press feedback. On the Nomad, closing the Layers panel or the Pages box no
  longer leaves a black box over the painting. Older firmware behaves as before.
- **Watercolor mode**, the droplet in the color bar: with transparent paint,
  brushes paint watercolor that lifts, blends and runs downhill as you tilt the
  tablet, and shapes and flat fills lay their whole area as one wash. The stroke
  goes on as a flat glaze while the pen is down and starts to move once you lift
  it. The droplet ripples while paint is still moving; tap it then to **blow-dry**
  everything at once.
- **Wet canvas:** slide the wetness slider beside the droplet up to wet the
  canvas, so new paint bleeds into what's already there, or all the way down to
  dry it. Watercolor glazes over the paint beneath it, loosening more of it the
  wetter the canvas.
- **Masking fluid**, beside the droplet: paint it on with any tool and nothing
  reaches under it, not paint, erasing or running watercolor. Hold its button
  and slide onto **Peel** to peel it all off.
- **Wet brush pen:** choose Dry or Wet in the Brush pen's settings. The wet one
  holds ink, so tap a color to dip it, and its ink runs through the water and
  pools downhill.
- **Page actions:** duplicate, delete or clear a page, or clear the current
  layer, from the page button on the Manta or the Pages box on the Nomad. They
  replace the Clear button.
- **Tap with two fingers to undo, three to redo.**
- **Paintings save themselves** once they have a name, so there's no Save
  button. A new painting stays in the app until you name it with **Save painting
  as…**.
- Transparent paint, watercolor and the flat brush keep up with the pen, and
  big washes run about twice as fast.

Download **monopaint.apk** and follow the [sideload instructions](https://github.com/mpdairy/monopaint#sideload-onto-a-manta).
Update with `adb install -r monopaint.apk` to keep your paintings and settings.
